name: What to Use When
description: Routes single-output requests to the best-fit included Microsoft 365 Copilot 1p agents and reserves Cowork for long-running or multi-output work.
author: Gaurav Mahajan
coverImageAlt: A central selector routes one task sphere along a cyan-lit path toward the best of four abstract workstations.
coverImagePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: AI.Tedt.org skill gallery cover
Primary request: a single task sphere enters a compass-like mechanical selector and is routed along one illuminated path to the best-matched one of several distinct abstract workstations
Scene/backdrop: spare warm-paper decision table with a deep slate field and generous negative space
Subject: one central routing selector, one incoming sphere, four distinct destination forms, and a cyan chosen path with one small orange pivot
Style/medium: premium editorial illustration with tactile dimensional detail
Composition/framing: exact 16:10 landscape; crop-safe focal subject centered; no essential detail in the outer 8%; destinations remain abstract and logo-free; clear at card size
Lighting/mood: discerning, efficient, calm, quietly technical
Color palette: warm paper #F8F6F0, slate #101820, navy #00446F, cyan #00A9E0, sparing orange #E86027
Constraints: no text, letters, numbers, symbols, pseudo-writing, vendor marks, logos, trademarks, or watermark; no paw imagery or paw logo; no cats or cat silhouettes; no product UI or Microsoft Fluent branding
Correction: replace the compass star and needle with a plain rotating selector disk, scale the entire selector and all four destination forms down so every meaningful form sits fully inside the inner 84% of the frame, and leave clean negative space around it
